name: Electricity Maps
description: Live map of grid carbon intensity and electricity mix by country and zone, with hourly history. The app and its data parsers are open source and actively developed by a community of contributors.
embedNote: Site sends a frame-blocking header, so the preview opens in a new tab

Data Licensing.note: Live view is free; historical data and the commercial API are paid

Technical Accessibility.note: Web and mobile app; API requires a key

Data Standards.note: Documented zone data and JSON API

Infrastructure.note: Company hosted; the app can be self-hosted from the repo

Community Governance.note: Company stewarded with a large contributor community
